description.zh: 把本机已登录的 WorkBuddy（腾讯 CodeBuddy Code 桌面版）模型接入 MPI：直连其 OpenAI 兼容网关，工具调用由 pi 执行、支持流式与真实 usage，并每天自动签到领取积分。不再需要 WorkBuddy CLI。
description.en: Brings the models of a locally signed-in WorkBuddy desktop app into MPI by talking to its OpenAI-compatible gateway directly: tool calls execute on the pi side, with streaming and real usage; daily check-in credits are claimed automatically. No WorkBuddy CLI required.

guide.zh:
前置：本机已安装并登录 WorkBuddy 桌面端，且能直连 `www.workbuddy.cn`（公司代理/DNS 拦截会导致不可用）。

启用后：
1. 应用在本机内存里解密 WorkBuddy 登录态（不落盘、不上传）。
2. 从账号目录 `/v3/config` 读模型与真实上下文/输出上限。
3. 起本机透传代理（默认 127.0.0.1:8096，占用自动顺延）：把 `/v1/chat/completions` 转发到 WorkBuddy 的 `/v2/chat/completions`，只注入最新 token 与身份头。
4. 把 provider `workbuddy` 写进 `~/.pi/agent/models.json`（首次写入前备份到应用数据目录）。
5. 每天自动签到一次（同一天不重复）。

修改服务代码后必须完全退出 MPI 再打开（仅停用/启用无效，同一进程的模块缓存不会失效）。启用后请新建会话或重启 MPI，模型选择器里才会出现 WorkBuddy 分组。

工具调用：代理原样透传 tools / tool_choice / tool_calls / role:"tool"，由 pi 在自己这边执行——代理不执行任何东西，MPI 的只读/沙盒/审批权限门照常生效。

配置说明：
· 「接入的模型」留空 = 账号目录里的全部模型；填逗号分隔的 id 只接其中几个。
· 「每日自动签到」关掉后不会自动领取，下次启用时仍会尝试。
· 「并发上限」限制同时打给上游的请求数（默认 4）。

这是第三方接入，用的是你自己账号的额度；WorkBuddy 客户端升级后接口可能变化，届时应用会报错但不影响 MPI 其它功能。

图片：账号目录里 `supportsImages` 的模型可直接发图；目录不准时用「支持图片的模型」显式覆盖。本代理跑在回环地址上，MPI 的 image-ref 扩展（只该对接 Strata 视觉服务）可能把历史图片换成 `data:image/x-strata-path;base64,<本机路径>` 引用，代理会自动读回 `~/.cache/mpi-image-ref/` 里的文件还原成真图再转发。上游偶发返回 `code 11135`（图片无法识别）时代理会自动重试 1 次。
guide.en:
Prerequisite: WorkBuddy desktop is installed and signed in on this machine, and `www.workbuddy.cn` is reachable directly (a corporate proxy/DNS block will break it).

After enabling:
1. The app decrypts the WorkBuddy sign-in in memory (never written to disk or uploaded).
2. It reads the model catalog and real context/output limits from `/v3/config`.
3. It starts a local pass-through proxy (127.0.0.1:8096 by default; next free port if busy): `/v1/chat/completions` is forwarded to WorkBuddy's `/v2/chat/completions` with the latest token and identity headers injected.
4. Provider `workbuddy` is written into `~/.pi/agent/models.json` (backed up into the app data dir first).
5. One daily check-in is claimed (once per day).

After changing service code you must quit MPI completely and reopen it (disable/enable alone does not reload it). Create a new thread or restart MPI after enabling so the WorkBuddy group appears in the model picker.

Tool calls: the proxy passes tools / tool_choice / tool_calls / role:"tool" through untouched; pi executes them on its side. The proxy never executes anything, so MPI's read-only/sandbox/approval gate still applies.

Config:
· "Models" empty = every model in the account catalog; a comma-separated list narrows it.
· Turning off the daily check-in skips auto-claiming; it will try again next time the app is enabled.
· "Concurrency" caps simultaneous upstream requests (default 4).

This is an unofficial integration using your own account quota. A WorkBuddy update may change the API; the app will then report an error without affecting the rest of MPI.

Images: models with `supportsImages` in the account catalog can take images; override with "Vision models" when the catalog is wrong. If the upstream intermittently answers `code 11135` (image not recognized), the proxy retries once; if it still fails, resend, use another image, or switch models.

label.zh: 接入的模型（逗号分隔，留空 = 全部）

hint.zh: 可用 id 见本页日志「模型 …」几行（来自账号目录 /v3/config）。
hint.en: See the "model …" log lines on this page for ids available to this account.

hint.zh: 每天第一次启用/启动 MPI 时领取一次；同一天不会重复请求。
hint.en: Claimed once on the first enable/startup of the day; repeats are skipped.

label.zh: 支持图片的模型（逗号分隔，留空 = 按账号目录）
label.en: Vision models (comma-separated; empty = follow the catalog)

hint.zh: 默认按 /v3/config 的 supportsImages（并排除 disabledMultimodal）；目录不准时在这里显式指定，被点名的模型才会带 image 输入。
hint.en: Defaults to supportsImages from /v3/config (minus disabledMultimodal); list ids here to override when the catalog is wrong.

label.zh: 并发上限（同时打给上游的请求数）

hint.zh: 工具轮与多会话同时使用时会有并发请求；上限只控制同时打给上游的数量。
hint.en: Tool turns and multiple threads can overlap; this caps how many requests hit the upstream at once.
